name: NRB Bearings Ltd
title: NRB Bearings Ltd - 530367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: NRB Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 19.2% to INR370 crore and PAT 15% to INR38 crore; standalone PAT up 31.7%.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of INR370 crore (vs INR310 crore) and PAT of INR38 crore (vs INR33 crore). Standalone sales grew 14.7% YoY, PAT 31.7% and EBITDA 21.7%. The call focused on the diversification push into aerospace (via the MTR/Mahant Tool acquisition), electrification, off-highway, and robotics, plus a revised FY31 revenue outlook. Management declined to give quarterly or specific FY27 guidance and repeatedly redirected questions to the longer-term track.

financial_highlights.value: Up about INR10 crore QoQ vs typical INR90-92 crore run-rate
financial_highlights.change: Attributed to power, logistics and petroleum-linked cost escalation

segments.name: Aerospace / defence (MTR, Mahant Tool Room)
segments.commentary: Acquired about a month before the call; order book about INR30 crore, with a further INR20 crore in regular non-aerospace defence (total about INR50 crore). Management projects INR300 crore revenue and INR90 crore profit contribution by 2031, though the timing was not committed.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.commentary: 14% of total revenue, up from 11%, with industrial growth of 34%.

segments.name: Heavy mobility / off-highway
segments.commentary: Accredited US defence supplier for heavy vehicles; supplies French and US defence programmes. JCB UK named as a customer at the AGM.

segments.name: Electrification / EV
segments.commentary: Management says about 70% of its applications are EV-agnostic (common to ICE, hybrid and EV). A BMW i steering product launches in 2027. Electrification vertical formed; more announcements promised in 3-6 months.

segments.name: Unitec JV (industrial cylindrical roller bearings)
segments.commentary: INR110 crore investment for INR130 crore capacity; plant to be commissioned by April 2027 at Aurangabad (Shendra) after relocating from Hyderabad. Land and a partly ready building already bought.

segments.name: NRB USA
segments.commentary: First win at Columbia, South Carolina facility: high-precision planet pins for a GM Corvette programme via a tier-1 transmission customer, about 300,000 peak volume.

guidance_outlook: FY31 revenue vision of about INR3,000 crore; management said the earlier INR2,500 crore target is too low, and that the trailing 12-month growth rate compounded gives about INR2,700-2,730 crore by FY31.
Management declined to commit to FY27 growth (analyst asked about 15-20%) and does not give quarterly guidance; company will give a fuller nominated-business update annually.
Margin guidance reiterated at 18-20% on an annual basis; management says quarterly margins may vary.
Unitec JV commissioning targeted by April 2027.
Capex: total programme INR270 crore, of which INR60 crore spent and about INR100 crore ordered or in process; management says INR100 crore of capex yields about INR130 crore of sales.
Lifetime nominated business raised to about INR1,100 crore from INR800 crore, mainly due to the US Corvette win (about USD300,000 peak volume).
capex_capacity: Total capex programme INR270 crore: INR60 crore spent, around INR100 crore ordered or being ordered, rest to follow.
Unitec JV: INR110 crore investment, INR130 crore capacity, commissioning by April 2027 at Aurangabad (Shendra); moved from Hyderabad due to logistics and cost concerns.
NRB USA (South Carolina) is a new Make-in-USA facility now receiving production orders.
Data centre bearings are in product development stage; no timeline announced.
demand_pricing: Other-expense inflation (power, logistics, petroleum-linked) addressed through value engineering (VAVE) and price increases.
Aerospace: Sukhoi-30 plain spherical bearing order cited as a breakthrough; management says only a handful of global firms make this bearing.
Robotics/humanoids and automation: customised precision components and bearings; HAAS automotive order cited.
SNL Bearings (subsidiary) is a strong contributor with lower price point; management has no concrete plan to merge it.
